question: Should Telegram expose standalone `pin` and `unpin` message-tool actions, and what gate plus target semantics should protect them?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the feature grants agents persistent chat-state mutation power through privileged Telegram bot credentials and introduces an operator-facing action default.

options.title: Approve gated explicit actions
options.body: Add Telegram-plugin-owned `pin` and `unpin` actions behind an explicit action gate, require a concrete `messageId` unless maintainers approve implicit unpin, and require live Telegram proof before merge.

options.title: Keep delivery pin only
options.body: Do not expose standalone pin/unpin actions yet and keep the existing `--pin` delivery hint limited to messages OpenClaw just sent.

options.title: Request a design note first
options.body: Ask for a small design covering admin-right expectations, per-account gating, implicit unpin behavior, notification defaults, and forum-topic semantics before implementation.

recommendation.title: Approve gated explicit actions
recommendation.body: Add Telegram-plugin-owned `pin` and `unpin` actions behind an explicit action gate, require a concrete `messageId` unless maintainers approve implicit unpin, and require live Telegram proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The requested behavior extends the Telegram discovery and action-runtime seams that gumadeiras consolidated.
